name: Oxford Flowers 102
description: Oxford Flowers 102 is an image classification dataset containing 102 flower categories, with 40 to 258 images per category.
citation: Nilsback, M.-E., & Zisserman, A. (2008). Automated Flower Classification over a Large Number of Classes. Indian Conference on Computer Vision, Graphics and Image Processing (ICVGIP).
